classification: deterministic mathematical control; not audio-quality evidence

source_window_mirror.rule: regular starts by chunk-overlap; if next regular position is before total end, append max(0,total-chunk) unless duplicate
source_window_mirror.weight_rule: per-chunk ones; nonfirst prefix sin^2(pi/2*j/fade_len); nonlast suffix cos^2(pi/2*j/overlap); divide accumulated signal by accumulated weights

orthogonal_equal_variance_midpoint.interpretation: toy equal-weight uncorrelated residual midpoint; zero covariance is sufficient for this variance identity, not a claim of statistical independence or a measured audio artifact

chunk_lock_vs_whole_track.protected_cutoff_rule: closed protected bands; residual retained only for strict 1500 < f < 8000 Hz
chunk_lock_vs_whole_track.interpretation: per-chunk Fourier locks can leak on the whole-track grid after time-window stitching; global projection is only a numerical counterexample and may alter temporal behavior
